    StartersAlpa Chino's peanut barsPeanut caramel bars coated in milk chocolateHow to make it150g brown sugar3 tbsp golden syrup80g butter250g roasted peanuts150g milk chocolateBoil the sugar, golden syrup and butter together for 3 minutes.Stir in the peanuts and press into a lined tray.Pour over the melted milk chocolate.Chill until firm, then cut into bars.Four Leaf's jungle banh mi bitesBaguette bites with pork pâté, char siu, pickled carrot, cucumber and corianderHow to make it1 carrot100g daikon100ml white vinegar2 tbsp caster sugar2 small baguettes100g pork pate200g char siu pork1 Lebanese cucumber1 bunch coriander1 red chilliCut the carrot and daikon into matchsticks and quick-pickle in the vinegar and sugar.Split the baguettes and spread with pate.Fill with char siu, drained pickles, cucumber, coriander and chilli.Cut into bites.Prawn rice paper rolls with peanut sauceKirk stays in character, even for the rolls.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsFlaming Dragon green curryChicken thigh green curry with Thai eggplant in coconut milkHow to make it3 tbsp green curry paste800ml coconut milk800g chicken thighs, sliced2 tbsp fish sauce1 tbsp palm sugar200g Thai eggplant1 bunch Thai basil300g jasmine riceFry the curry paste in the thick top of the coconut milk until it splits.Add the chicken, the rest of the coconut milk, fish sauce, palm sugar and eggplant. Simmer.Cook the rice by the absorption method.Stir through the Thai basil and serve over rice.Base camp beef phoThe base camp kitchenHow to make itAs written, serves 4Spiced beef broth with charred onion, ginger, star anise and cinnamon over rice noodles and paper-thin raw beef, with bean sprouts, Thai basil, lime and chilli.Char a halved onion and a 6cm piece of ginger under the grill.Simmer 1.5kg beef bones in 3L water for 3 hours with the onion, ginger, 4 star anise, a cinnamon stick and 4 cloves, skimming.Strain and season with 3 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tbsp sugar.Soak 400g rice noodles and divide into bowls with 300g paper-thin raw eye fillet.Pour over the boiling broth.Serve with sprouts, Thai basil, lime and chilli.SweetsMango sticky riceSweet coconut sticky rice with sliced and glossy.Warm the coconut milk with the caster sugar and a pinch of salt, stir into the rice and rest.Slice the mangoes, spoon a little salty coconut cream alongside and scatter with sesame seeds.Portnoy's mango raspberry fruit jelliesHe wants jelly beans very, very badlyHow to make itAs written, serves 4Soft fruit pastilles of mango and raspberry purée set with pectin, cut into cubes and rolled in sugar, piled in a bowl with jelly beans.Line a 20cm square tin with baking paper.Bring 250g mango purée and 250g raspberry purée to the boil with 25g pectin mixed into 50g sugar.Add 450g
